phase_name: Original Phase 9: Whole-Slide Image Processing and Multiple Instance Learning

audit.gchtid_dataset_nature: 31,096 isolated 224x224 PNG image tiles; unlinked to slide IDs or patient IDs
audit.clinical_csv: HMU-GC-Clinical.csv (300 patients; unlinked to GCHTID image tiles)

environment.openslide_python: Not installed (requires native OpenSlide C DLLs not present in system PATH)

slide_reading.coordinate_system: Level-0 reference coordinate invariance (read_region location is strictly in Level-0 pixels)

tissue_detection.method: Thumbnail HSV saturation/value thresholding with morphological opening and closing
tissue_detection.acceleration: 2D Integral Image (summed-area table) for O(1) region queries

embedding_integration.status: Interface implemented; extraction blocked awaiting genuine WSI data (fake embedding generation prohibited)

multiple_instance_learning.bag_isolation: Strictly one bag per slide; zero inter-slide patch mixing
multiple_instance_learning.training_status: Blocked awaiting genuine WSIs and verified slide-level diagnosis labels
